name: 3D Box: Box 0 moves north · 2t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Box 0: 4 cells, starting at (0, 4, 1) through (3, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 2: 3 cells, starting at (3, 3, 2) through (4, 3, 2); Box 1: 3 cells, starting at (3, 4, 2) through (3, 4, 4). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Box 1 moves 1 down.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
